metadata.description: Gemini Sports for Claude: the football scouting and planning plugin from Gemini Sports

plugins.name: ask-gemini
plugins.description: Football scouting assistant from Gemini Sports for staff at Gemini Sports clubs: find and compare players, read scout reports, review transfers, loans and contracts, plan the squad, and manage watchlists and pipeline boards. Connects to the Gemini Sports MCP server.
